chapters.title: Your business. One workspace.
chapters.narration: Welcome to Keeper B M A. Explore your business in one workspace.

chapters.title: Start with a clear overview.
chapters.narration: Start with your overview. Choose point of sale, team, finance, or marketing.

chapters.title: Organize your products.
chapters.narration: Add products and prices. Import your catalog and receive supplier purchases.

chapters.title: Sign in. Ring up a sale.
chapters.narration: Sign in as a demo cashier. Add products and choose a customer or walk-in. Payments here are simulated.

chapters.title: Keep the sale connected.
chapters.narration: See the cashier, customer, total, and points earned on each sample receipt.

chapters.title: Plan your team by branch.
chapters.narration: Plan each branch’s shifts. Assign Jason and Kay to Monday, nine to two, and review planned hours.

chapters.title: Track time. Review hours.
chapters.narration: Track hours, breaks, and gross pay estimates. No payroll payments are made.

chapters.title: Bring customers back with points.
chapters.narration: Preview phone membership and adjustable customer rewards. No real texts are sent.

chapters.title: See the numbers together.
chapters.narration: Review sales, costs, expenses, and tax collected. This is not full bookkeeping or tax filing.

chapters.title: Plan your next campaign.
chapters.narration: Plan campaigns, meetings, tasks, and follow ups. Nothing is posted or sent.

chapters.title: Personal finance is here too.
chapters.narration: Explore personal income, expenses, and monthly reports with fictional sample records.

chapters.title: Try it yourself.
chapters.narration: Try the demo at keeper B M A dot com. No signup needed.
